conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Could you give another example of a statistical construct like that?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Certainly, another good example is the "average family" when discussing household income or spending habits.

conversation.message: What if there were no "average" to measure?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Without an "average," it would be much harder to identify general trends and make comparisons across different groups. We'd likely focus more on individual case studies and their unique characteristics.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So, it would be harder to see the bigger picture?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
